verdict.rationale: Baseten is a model inference and training platform, so versioning and rolling back deployed workloads is a fair question to ask of it. The pack documents stable development, staging, and production environments and config-driven `truss push` deploys, but nothing about versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations. Environments and config files a user could keep in source control are adjacent features or user-side workarounds, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
